source.title: First Class Passenger List, S.S. "Titanic", from Southampton and Cherbourg to New York (via Queenstown), Wednesday, 10th April, 1912 ("Third Proof"): the Cave list
source.what: A "Third Proof" of the White Star Line's printed first-class passenger list for the maiden voyage, with cabin numbers set against the names, found on the body of saloon steward Herbert Cave (body no. 218, one of the 306 recovered by the cable ship Mackay-Bennett; buried at Fairview Cemetery, Halifax). The original is held by the Nova Scotia Archives (Medical Examiner, City of Halifax, RG 41 vol. 76 no. 218); its six list pages run alphabetically from Allen to Young in two columns, first-class passengers and their servants, with cabins mostly on decks A to E.
